note: Avoyelles Parish (FIPS 22009) parcel polygons are not publicly queryable. The only ArcGIS layer titled 'Parcels - LA - Avoyelles Parish' (gissrv1.romlc.net LA_Assessors MapServer/2) returns 'Token Required' for the layer and the service root. The EFS Edge assessor ArcGIS directory (efsedge.com/arcgis/rest, Avoyelles_Parish folder) redirects to an EFS login page. The assessor viewer at efsedge.com/avoyelles is browser-only with no exposed service. LandGrid parcels (services8.arcgis.com) also require a token. The parish website lists no GIS or parcel service. Remaining parcel sources (Regrid, Dynamo Spatial, Acres) are commercial.
